facts.fact: The page states that 64% of consumers will only consider a service provider if it has at least a 4-star rating, with no source named.
facts.quote: **64% of consumers** will only even consider a service provider if they have at least a 4-star rating.

facts.fact: The page states that a Google Business Profile is completely free to use.
facts.quote: Your Google Business Profile (GBP) is, without a doubt, your single most important local marketing tool, and it's completely free.

facts.fact: The page states that the top three businesses shown in Google's map pack for a local search are pulled directly from their Google Business Profile listings.
facts.quote: those top three businesses that pop up in the map pack? They're pulled directly from their GBP listings.

facts.fact: The landscaping sector is expected to generate $178 billion in 2024, according to the page.
facts.quote: The landscaping sector is expected to generate **$178 billion in 2024**, and no single company has more than a **5% market share**.

facts.fact: The lawn care industry is projected to hit $188.8 billion in 2025, according to the page.
facts.quote: The lawn care industry is booming, projected to hit **$188.8 billion** in 2025.

facts.fact: In 2023, lawn care campaigns on Google Ads saw click-through rates rise 121% year-over-year, per a third-party benchmark from Evergrow Marketing cited by the page.
facts.quote: in 2023, lawn care campaigns on Google Ads saw click-through rates jump by **121%** year-over-year, and conversion rates climbed by **47%**.

facts.fact: Adwave, by its own account, places TV ads across more than 100 premium channels such as ESPN, Hulu, and NBC.
facts.quote: place it across more than **100** premium channels like ESPN, Hulu, and NBC.

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a targeted local TV campaign can launch with a budget as small as $30 per day.
facts.quote: You can launch a targeted local campaign with a budget as small as **$30/day**.

facts.fact: The page's sample referral script offers a $25 credit to both the existing customer and the friend they refer, applied on the friend's first service.
facts.quote: we give a **$25 credit** to both you and your friend on their first service.

facts.fact: The page's example Facebook/Instagram/Nextdoor ad audience targets homeowners aged 35-65 within a 5-mile radius of a profitable route.
facts.quote: **Audience:** Homeowners aged 35-65 in a 5-mile radius of your most profitable route.

facts.fact: The U.S. lawn care industry is projected to reach $77 billion by 2030 (third-party projection cited from Mordor Intelligence).
facts.quote: The U.S. lawn care industry is projected to hit **$77 billion by 2030** as more households outsource their yard work.

facts.fact: Commercial clients account for 54.2% of U.S. lawn care revenue, according to the cited market data.
facts.quote: A massive **54.2% of that revenue** comes from commercial clients who value reliability above all else

facts.fact: A commonly cited sales statistic says 80% of sales require five follow-up touches (source not named).
facts.quote: A well-known sales stat says **80% of sales** require five follow-up touches.

facts.fact: A commonly cited sales statistic says 44% of salespeople give up after just one follow-up (source not named).
facts.quote: **44% of salespeople** give up after just one.

facts.fact: Rule of thumb for an established lawn care business is to spend 5-10% of total revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: put **5-10% of your total revenue** back into marketing.

facts.fact: A new lawn care business trying to build its customer list quickly should consider spending 10-12% of total revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: you should probably push that to the **10-12% range**.

facts.fact: Vendor Adwave states that its TV ad service lets businesses run TV ads on major channels with a budget as small as $30 per day.
facts.quote: it lets you run actual TV ads on major channels with a budget as tiny as **$30/day**.

facts.fact: Illustrative example: if average customer lifetime value is $2,500, spending $250 to acquire a customer is presented as still wildly profitable.

facts.fact: Suggested follow-up cadence is to send a quick email to a quote recipient two days after sending the quote.
